claims.head: The Blackhawks will send Cole and Vlasic at Scheifele
claims.call: The Blackhawks’ P3 (Cole and Vlasic) spends at least 73% of its 5-on-5 time against the Jets’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Blackhawks keep sending Cole and Vlasic out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Jeff Blashill has been picking a defense pair for the other team’s top line. Tonight the Jets’ first line is Scheifele, Connor and Perfetti.

CHI.head: A slightly uphill night for the Blackhawks
CHI.body: Even though Chicago has home-ice advantage, Winnipeg has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Blackhawks can tip it if they keep dangerous shots away.
